quality.label: Quality setting for Tidal:
quality.description: The maximum streaming quality to request from Tidal.

option_descriptions.LOSSLESS: 16-bit / 44.1 kHz — CD quality, plays on any device.
option_descriptions.HI_RES_LOSSLESS: Up to 24-bit / 192 kHz — hi-res; needs a player/DAC that supports it.

auth_instructions.label: Use the link icon to open Tidal and approve Music Assistant. The code is filled in for you. Then select Next to finish linking.

user.title: Link your Tidal account
user.description: Open Tidal with the link icon and approve Music Assistant, then select Next. On another device, go to link.tidal.com and enter the code shown on the next screen.

device_login.title: Waiting for Tidal
device_login.description: Waiting for you to approve Music Assistant in Tidal. On another device, go to link.tidal.com and enter the code shown. A fresh code appears automatically if it expires.
device_login.progress_text: Waiting for you to approve on Tidal...

abort.login_failed: Could not link your Tidal account. Please start the setup again.

manifest.description: Stream music, playlists, and exclusives in lossless FLAC quality.
